Who we are

About Study Hub Official

Educational support designed to make academic learning more organized, accessible, and understandable.

Our story

Helping students approach academic work with clarity.

Study Hub Official is an educational support brand founded by Ehtsham Ul Haq in Pakistan. Our goal is to make academic learning more organized, accessible, and understandable for university students.

We focus on practical guidance, clear communication, and helping students develop the knowledge and confidence needed for their academic journey. Support is tailored to the task and requirements shared by each student.

Home/Faqs
Frequently asked questions

Questions, answered clearly

Find practical answers about services, requesting assistance, quotations, and privacy.

Frequently asked questions

Questions, answered clearly

Here are a few helpful details before you get in touch.

What services does Study Hub Official provide?
We provide educational guidance for assignments, quiz preparation, GDB topics, lecture learning, LMS navigation, academic projects, and internship report structure and formatting.
Do you support Virtual University students?
Yes. The services are designed with Virtual University students in mind, and university students with similar learning-support needs can also inquire.
How can I request academic assistance?
Contact us through WhatsApp or use the inquiry form on the Contact page. Share the course, task requirements, and deadline so we can discuss the next steps.
How do I receive a price quotation?
Share the task instructions, scope, and deadline first. The details and any agreed price are discussed with you before proceeding.
Can I ask questions through WhatsApp?
Yes. WhatsApp is the primary contact method. Inquiry buttons open a chat with a prepared message; you still need to review and send it.
Can you help me understand difficult course topics?
Yes. You can ask about explanations, topic-wise revision, lecture summaries, practice questions, and study planning.
Do you support final-project and internship course codes?
Yes. Use the Project & Internship Courses directory to search the course codes you supplied, select a code, and prepare an inquiry with your project or internship requirements. Course availability and official requirements should be confirmed with VU.
Can you remove plagiarism completely?
No service can responsibly guarantee a zero-similarity score. We can help improve original expression, source attribution, citations, and reference formatting. We do not help bypass detection tools or misrepresent copied work as original.
How is my personal information handled?
In static mode, inquiry forms prepare text for WhatsApp or your email app, and you decide what to send. If the optional server is configured, it may forward text inquiries by email. Review the Privacy Policy before sharing personal information.
Which WhatsApp numbers and email can I contact?

You can contact WhatsApp 1 at 03048244071, WhatsApp 2 at 03156393346, or email vupersonal4u@gmail.com. Review the prefilled message and press Send in the app you choose.

Where can I find your YouTube channels?

Visit the Contact page for the official channel links: Study Hub Official, Study Hub Official Lite, Ehtsham ul haq, and VU Internship Projects.

Home / Privacy Policy
Privacy information

Privacy Policy

How the single-file Study Hub Official website handles your information.

Updated: 1 November 2026

1. Offline website and local storage

This is a standalone HTML file. It does not have a central database, secure server-side authentication, or a backend to receive inquiries. Its management login only controls the visible UI in this browser. When you choose Save in this browser, the form fields are saved in your current browser's localStorage for this local file/site origin. The saved inquiries are only available in the same browser and origin, and may disappear if you clear site data, use a different browser, open a copy from another path, or use private browsing. Anyone with access to the same browser profile may be able to access its local storage. The public request status board shows only reference IDs, request types, timestamps and status; private inquiry fields are not shown there.

2. Contact and sharing

The contact, VU Subjects and Projects & Internships forms prepare inquiry text. WhatsApp buttons open WhatsApp with a message for you to review and send. The Email button opens your device's default email application; it does not send mail directly. Copy copies the message. Saving in your browser does not send the inquiry or notify Study Hub Official.

3. Information you enter

Fields may include your name, phone, university, course, service, deadline and task details. Do not include passwords, OTPs, LMS credentials, identity documents, financial details or other sensitive data in forms or stored inquiries.

4. Backups and deletion

The public Request Status board lets visitors read reference/status information from their current browser without login. The Management workspace has a client-side admin login screen (not secure server authentication); only this admin interface offers status editing, deletion and export controls. Export files (CSV or JSON) are downloaded to your device; protect or delete those files yourself. Clearing browser storage removes the local records. There is no automatic cross-device synchronization or recovery.

5. External links

WhatsApp, email applications, Virtual University websites and any other third-party destinations have their own privacy policies. Only when you choose to open or send through them is information handled by those services.

6. Security and analytics

LocalStorage is not an encrypted, access-controlled database. This browser-only management feature should not be used as a production system to collect or manage confidential student records. This HTML file includes no external scripts or tracking scripts.

7. Contact

For questions, contact Study Hub Official via WhatsApp or email at vupersonal4u@gmail.com.

Home/Terms
Legal information

Terms of Service

Terms for using the Study Hub Official website and requesting educational guidance.

Last updated: 23 October 2026

1. Nature of the service

Study Hub Official provides educational guidance and learning support, which may include explaining course concepts, helping organize student work, practice and revision support, document formatting guidance, project planning, and internship report structure support. Specific work is agreed in direct communication before proceeding.

2. Student responsibility and academic integrity

Students remain responsible for understanding their course material, following their institution's rules, checking instructions and deadlines, and submitting their own work. Study Hub Official does not offer to log into a student's LMS account, complete or submit graded quizzes or assessments on a student's behalf, or guarantee grades or academic outcomes.

3. Originality and similarity review

Originality support focuses on proper attribution, citations, reference formatting, and helping students express ideas in their own words. No specific similarity percentage or academic outcome is guaranteed. The service does not include bypassing detection systems, concealing copied work, or misrepresenting authorship.

4. Scope, deadlines, and fees

The scope, requirements, timeline, and any fee should be discussed and agreed directly before support begins. A message from the website is an inquiry, not an accepted order or guarantee that a service is available by a particular deadline.

5. Accuracy and availability

Educational guidance is provided to support learning. Users should check official course instructions and institutional resources, especially where a requirement or deadline may change. The website and its links are provided on an as-available basis.

6. Contact and inquiry messages

Pressing Save to Firebase stores the completed form online in Google Firestore, subject to access rules and service availability. The website also offers optional WhatsApp and email links; saving a request does not automatically send it on those channels or guarantee a response. Announcement questions may receive public administrator replies.

7. Third-party services

Firebase, Cloudinary, WhatsApp and YouTube are operated by third parties and have their own privacy and service terms.

8. Website use

Do not use the website to send unlawful material, unauthorized account credentials, or sensitive data that is not needed for an inquiry. Do not attempt to interfere with the website's operation or security.

9. Changes and contact

These terms may be revised if the website or its services change. For questions about these terms, contact Study Hub Official through WhatsApp at 03048244071, WhatsApp at 03156393346, or vupersonal4u@gmail.com.
